bio_en: Artashes Andreasian, known as Suren, was a Samatian who studied at the Gevorgian seminary in Etchmiadzin, where in February 1891 the students of three classes walked out in protest against its clerical administration. Calm, upright and outwardly cold but fearsome against falsehood, he came to know and love the people of the homeland to whom he devoted his life. With Babken Siuni (Petros Parian) and Shahen Gnuni he belonged to the ARF's Constantinople fighters. He was killed in the Samatia fight of 1896 when the group found its way blocked by troops.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Birth year not stated.
